name: Voltage Daikaiju
type_description: Dual voltage conditioner/shaper: scaling, offset, slew, LFO
bom_parts_summary: LM358, TL072, TL074, TL082 ICs; 1N4148 diodes; VTL5C vactrols
components_evidence: Page BOM lists only through-hole/DIP parts (electrolytic/film caps, resistors, pots, 1N4148 diodes, LEDs, DIP op-amps LM358/TL072/TL074/TL082, jacks, SPDT toggle, VTL5C vactrols); no SMD package named anywhere on page.

lineage.credit: If the Voltage Kaiju was a big module, the Voltage Daikaiju is giant.
lineage.source_is: Voltage Kaiju, an earlier Mechlab Industries eurorack module (LFO + dual voltage offset/scaler utility) that Voltage Daikaiju evolves from
lineage.quote: If the Voltage Kaiju was a big module, the Voltage Daikaiju is giant.

other_links: Spotify (We Boil the Sea, Younger Us)
notes: Two-channel voltage conditioner: scaling, offset, rise/fall slew with CV control, built-in normalled LFO, inverted outs per channel. No HP or licence stated on page.
